title: fix(metadata)!: DatabaseLoader keeps a row per object one package binds an action name to (ADR-0150 D4/D6)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg9wT4S3ivyTq9aC1e2gSKGS)_
epic:#31527#2 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CYsLFLV8NARzzJRCqi

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：同一个包把一个动作名绑到多个对象时，`DatabaseLoader` 现在每个绑定各存一行，绑定的对象写进现有的 `sys_metadata.bundle_member` 列，无对象的动作这一列仍为空。
- 为什么改：以前一个包同名的动作只存一行，后保存的覆盖先保存的；冷启动从数据库读回时只剩最后一个对象上的动作，另一个丢失，没有任何报错（ADR-0150 D6 允许一包同名多对象，D4 把动作身份定为 (包, 对象, 名)）。
- 风险与回滚：收窄有两处，都按 BREAKING 声明，第一方均为 0 例（最长对象名 32 字符）。一是对象名超过 100 字符的动作绑定，写入时会被拒绝。二是槽里有一条这样的旧行时，同包的无对象绑定不能再写入，报错会点名那条旧行；同包其它对象的写入照常进行。唯一键不变，不跑 DDL，不迁移不回填；旧行写入时才补这一列。只有 `@objectstack/metadata` 的运行代码有改动，metadata-protocol 和 cli 只加了测试。回滚即还原本 PR，已写入的行仍能被旧代码读（多出的行旧代码按名取最新）。
- 先看：`packages/metadata/src/package-slotted-store.ts` 的 `storedRowMemberOf`，以及 `database-loader.ts` 的 `slottedSaveTarget` 和 `registerRollback`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata exec vitest run src/metadata-manager-match-endpoint.test.ts src/migrations/bind-database-loader-row-packages.test.ts -t 32540`，预期 13 条全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无，由座位落地。Studio 覆盖行和 served-overrides 的同类问题放在 follow-up #32609。

Fixes #32540

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none — nothing a metadata author writes is added, removed or re-read; what moves is how many `sys_metadata` rows `DatabaseLoader` keeps for one package's action name and which of them a rollback writes
Skills-docs: none — no page under `skills/**` or `content/docs/**` teaches `DatabaseLoader`'s row keying (`git grep -n "bundle_member\|DatabaseLoader" -- 'skills/**' 'content/docs/**'`: only `content/docs/protocol/kernel/metadata-service.mdx`, which describes the loader as a control-plane opt-in and its cache, not its rows)

Claim 6817485186 by `epic:#31527#2`. Step 0 (`card-32540/step0.md`, main 874166b6): first-party top-level actions binding one name to two or more objects in one package: **0** (104 action declarations in 7 packages; the 4 multi-object names in `platform-objects` are object-inline actions, stored inside `object` rows); the real need is HotCRM's `log_call` / `log_meeting` / `schedule_meeting` on five objects each (#5510). No in-tree runtime wires `DatabaseLoader` (a control-plane opt-in). Triage 6816075952 ruled out (b) refuse and (c) warn against ADR-0150 D6/D4. The seat's ruling (fable, `decisions/32540-动作绑定对象存储列-裁决.md`) took **(a2)** with conditions C1–C9, met as follows.

## What changes

`@objectstack/metadata`:

- `package-slotted-store.ts`: new `storedRowMemberOf(type, item, column)`, the one reader of a row's member: a bundled type's member (`storedBundleMemberOf`, unchanged), an action's bound object (`null` object-less; a non-empty column first, else the body's object; `global` / `*` read as `null`), `undefined` for every other type. Module doc states the column's reading per type.
- `loaders/database-loader.ts`:
  - `slottedSaveTarget`: the `(package, name)` slot is chosen as before; within it, the write goes to the row of the body's member (now an action's object too), and a member with no row is inserted with `bundle_member` set. ⛔ Never over another binding's row.
  - Before any write of an action slot, a row written before its object was named (`bundle_member` NULL, body bound) has its column filled from its body (`nameUnnamedRows`; column only, no version, no history). Otherwise it would sit in the object-less bucket of the unique key and collide with the object-less binding's row.
  - `registerRollback`: names unnamed rows first; restores the row of the restored body's member; when that binding has no row, recreates it as its own row in the slot's one package.
  - Over-long object name (> `sys_metadata.bundle_member`'s `maxLength`, 100) refused at the write (save, or a rollback recreating the binding), naming the action, object and limit; never truncated.
  - A row written before, bound to such an object, cannot be named: `nameUnnamedRows` leaves it as it is (it keeps the object-less place of its package's bucket), and only a write into that place (the object-less binding's insert, or a re-bind of its package) is refused by `refuseUnnameableHolder`, naming that row, its object and the limit. Every other write of the slot goes on.
  - `readTypeRows` reads the member through `storedRowMemberOf`.
  - `bindReadRowPackage` (the plural read's column-only package bind): the slot is read as the unique key holds it once named (`namedRowColumnOf`); the package's own unnamed rows of the name are named first, and the bound row's object is written into `bundle_member` in the same update as `package_id`.
- `package-slotted-store.ts`: `namedRowColumnOf(type, item, column)` (the column an action row holds once named: its object when the column can store it, else `null`) and `STORED_MEMBER_MAX_LENGTH`, shared by the loader and the migration.
- `migrations/bind-database-loader-row-packages.ts`: `slotOf` includes an action's object (`namedRowColumnOf`), and a bind names the package's unnamed rows of the name first and the bound row's object in the same update, so a package's legacy row on one object binds beside its row on another with every `bundle_member` NULL.

Not changed: `ITEM_KEY_DISCRIMINATORS` (C1: `action` is not added; no canonical member, no `?member=` address); the `sys_metadata` object and its column description (C7); any metadata-protocol or cli source; `load` / `loadMany` / `loadManyKeyed`, which still answer one item per action name (the binding saved last), as the door's `MemoryLoader` and the manager's unscoped reads already do; removal (#32352: by package, every binding's row; one package on several objects is one holder).

## Moved answers (FROM → TO)

| # | Call | FROM (main 874166b6) | TO | Clause-② arm | Pin |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `DatabaseLoader.save('action', x, …)` for package P, a second object (or object-less beside bound) | updated P's one row in place: the earlier binding's body gone | a new row for the binding, `bundle_member` = its object (NULL object-less) | widening (fix) | match-endpoint `[#32540]` five shapes |
| 2 | a read of the rows (`list('action')` on a manager over them, cold boot) | served only the binding saved last | serves every binding | widening (fix) | same five, `coldServed` |
| 3 | a later save of one binding | overwrote the one row | updates that binding's row only | widening (fix) | "a later edit of one binding" |
| 4 | a save into a slot holding a row written before (`bundle_member` NULL, body on o1) | overwrote it | names it `o1` (column only) first; its own binding updates it in place; legacy o1 → object-less → o1 → o2 ends as **3** rows, cold read 3 | widening (fix) | "C3 — a row written before …" |
| 5 | `registerRollback('action', x, body on o1, v)` with rows on o1 and o2 | restored over the one row | restores the o1 row; o2 kept | widening (fix) | "a rollback by name restores the row of the object …" |
| 6 | the same where the slot holds no o1 row (a legacy row re-bound to o2) | overwrote the one row, moving the binding back to o1 | recreates the o1 binding as its own row; o2 kept; one `revert` history row | widening | "C9 — a rollback to a body bound to an object the slot holds no row of" |
| 7 | `DatabaseLoader.save` of an action bound to an object whose name is longer than 100 characters, or `registerRollback` recreating such a binding (C8) | stored (the column unused; the rollback restored over the one row) | refused naming the action, the object and the limit; nothing stored, never truncated | **narrowing** (BREAKING; first-party count 0: the longest first-party object name is 32 characters, measured over `*.object.ts`) | "C8 — an object name longer than …", "a rollback recreating a binding on an object longer than …" |
| 7b | while P's slot holds a row written before bound to such an object: P's save of the object-less binding, or a rollback recreating it | overwrote that row | refused naming that row (id), its object and the limit; nothing written | **narrowing** (BREAKING; same count 0) | "the object-less binding, saved or recreated by a rollback, is refused naming the long row …" |
| 7c | the same slot: a save of another (short) object, or a rollback recreating one | overwrote that row | stored as its own row beside it; the long row left as it is | widening (fix) | "a save of another object is stored beside it …", "a rollback restoring another object's binding …" |
| 8 | `migrateDatabaseLoaderRowPackages`, a legacy package-less row on o1 beside P's row on o2 or P's object-less row, every `bundle_member` NULL (as released writers left them) | left `slot-taken` | bound to P with `bundle_member` `o1`, P's unnamed row named first; a legacy row on an object over 100 characters beside P's object-less row stays `slot-taken` | widening (fix) | migration `[#32540]` (4 cases, unique key enforced) |
| 8b | `bindReadRowPackage` (boot priming's column-only bind) of the same legacy row, the same rows | no-op (one `(package, name)` slot) | bound to P with `bundle_member` `o1`, P's unnamed row named first | widening (fix) | "C3 — `bindReadRowPackage` of a legacy package-less row on o1 beside …" (2) |
| 3a | a package-less row on o1, then P saves o2 | P's save took the row over (overwrote it and bound it to P) | the row is kept and named `o1`; P's o2 binding is its own row | widening (fix) | "a package-less row on o1, then the package saves o2 …" |
| 3b | a rollback to an object-less body in a slot holding only bound rows | restored over the one row | recreates the object-less binding as its own row (C9) | widening | "a rollback to an object-less body in a slot holding only bound rows …" |
| 3c | the naming pass over a slot's rows | — (no naming) | fills `bundle_member` (the column only) on any writer's row of the slot whose body is bound to an object the column can store, a protocol overlay row (`source` `sys-metadata-repo`) included; protocol reads of an action ignore the column (C4 audit) | widening (no answer moves; the row's key moves to its own binding's place) | "the naming pass names any writer's row of the slot …" |

Rows 7 and 7b are the PR's narrowings (seat ruling: declare C8 and its full reach), so the changeset is `fix(metadata)!` with its BREAKING section and ADR-0087 disposition (`not-required (no-migration-prescription)`: no schema key moves, no stored body is rewritten), and the dogfood battery ran (Verification). Every other row is a widening.

## Reader audit (C4)

| Reader | Reads an action row's member? | Pin |
|---|---|---|
| `DatabaseLoader` (`readTypeRows`, `slottedSaveTarget`, `registerRollback`, `bindReadRowPackage`), the row-package migration | yes, through `storedRowMemberOf` only (C2) | match-endpoint, migration |
| metadata-protocol `overlayMemberValue` / `overlayMemberWhere` (repository member predicate), `overlayMemberOfBody`, `backfillOverlayBundleMembers` | no: `undefined` / no predicate / no update for `action`; the real index (node:sqlite) holds o1, o2, object-less as three rows and refuses a second of one | `overlay-index.test.ts` `[#32540]` |
| metadata-protocol `protocol-mutation-resync.ts` `addressOfRow` | yes, as the address's member, which is the binding's identity: only the moved binding re-converges | `protocol.cluster-mutation-fanout.test.ts` `[#32540]` |
| metadata-protocol `protocol-served-overrides.ts:152` → `getArtifactItem` (ignores `member` for non-discriminated types) | groups by member, but the artifact lookup ignores it | **follow-up #32609**, not in this PR |
| metadata-protocol `protocol-diff-delete-load.ts` hydration | no: reads bodies; its backfill call is the one above | — |
| plugin-security `upgrade-impact-report.ts:597` | no: reads the column only for `view` / `dashboard` / `report` / `translation` / `email_template`; `action` is not one of its overlay types | — |
| cli ownership ceremony (`organization-ownership-inventory` duplicate category, `-plan`, `-apply`) | as a generic key part: an action's bindings are distinct keys, a second row of one binding is a duplicate | `organization-ownership-plan.integration.test.ts` `[#32540]` |
| cli `stored-package-references.ts` | pair-member walk: `ITEM_KEY_DISCRIMINATORS` types only (never an action); package-less walk: the column as the finding's label | — |

Studio overlay rows written by metadata-protocol for an action still leave `bundle_member` NULL when written, so overlays of one package's name on o1 and o2 still share a key (C6). The loader's naming pass (row 3c) fills the column of such a row when the loader next writes that slot, the column only; the protocol's own write path is not changed here and is carried by #32609 together with the served-overrides lookup and the open question whether unscoped `loadMany('action')` should keep one item per binding.

A binding an earlier save already overwrote is not recoverable from `sys_metadata`; its versions remain in `sys_metadata_history`. Nothing here claims to restore it.
